---
title: "ICES R packages"
---

```{r}
source("R/status.R")

status <- read_status()
apis <- read_apis()
api_endpoints <- do.call(rbind, lapply(apis$apis, endpoint_table))
tab <- status_table(status)
n <- nrow(tab)

n_health <- table(factor(tab$health, levels = c("ok", "warning", "error")))
n_cran <- table(factor(tab$cran_status, levels = c("cran", "archived", "none")))
n_checks <- table(factor(tab$cran_checks, levels = c("OK", "NOTE", "WARNING", "ERROR", "FAILURE")))
n_universe <- sum(!is.na(tab$universe_build))
universe_failing <- sum(
  (!is.na(tab$universe_build) & tab$universe_build != "success") |
    tab$universe_checks %in% c("WARNING", "ERROR", "FAILURE")
)
unreleased <- tab[tab$unreleased, ]
with_prs <- tab[!is.na(tab$open_prs) & tab$open_prs > 0, ]
with_prs <- with_prs[order(-with_prs$open_prs), ]

# a simple table, with html in the cells
simple_table <- function(x, ...) {
  knitr::kable(x, format = "html", escape = FALSE, table.attr = 'class="table table-sm"', ...)
}
pkg_link <- function(pkg, url) sprintf('<a href="%s">%s</a>', url, pkg)
```

The R packages maintained by ICES, in the
[ices-tools-prod](https://github.com/ices-tools-prod) and
[ices-tools-dev](https://github.com/ices-tools-dev) GitHub organisations.
Updated `r updated(status)`.

**`r n` packages: `r n_health[["ok"]]` OK,
`r n_health[["warning"]]` need attention,
`r n_health[["error"]]` need action.**
See [Packages](packages.qmd) for the details of each package.

## At a glance

```{r}
simple_table(
  data.frame(
    c("CRAN", "CRAN checks", "r-universe", "GitHub", '<a href="apis.html">Web services</a>'),
    c(
      sprintf("%d on CRAN, %d archived, %d not on CRAN", n_cran[["cran"]], n_cran[["archived"]], n_cran[["none"]]),
      sprintf("%d OK, %d with notes, %d with warnings, %d with errors",
              n_checks[["OK"]], n_checks[["NOTE"]], n_checks[["WARNING"]], n_checks[["ERROR"]] + n_checks[["FAILURE"]]),
      sprintf("%d built, %d with failing builds or checks, %d not listed", n_universe, universe_failing, n - n_universe),
      sprintf("%d open issues, %d open pull requests, %d with unreleased changes",
              sum(tab$open_issues, na.rm = TRUE), sum(tab$open_prs, na.rm = TRUE), nrow(unreleased)),
      sprintf("%d %s, %d endpoints: %d unchanged, %d changed, %d with errors",
              length(apis$apis), if (length(apis$apis) == 1) "API" else "APIs", nrow(api_endpoints), sum(api_endpoints$status == "ok"),
              sum(api_endpoints$status == "changed"), sum(api_endpoints$status == "error"))
    )
  ),
  col.names = NULL
)
```

## Needs attention

```{r}
#| results: asis
issues <- status_issues(status, levels = c("error", "warning"))
# web service changes and errors
for (a in apis$apis) {
  for (e in a$endpoints) {
    if (e$status %in% c("changed", "error")) {
      issues <- rbind(issues, data.frame(
        package = a$name, github_url = paste0("api/", a$id, ".html"),
        level = if (e$status == "error") "error" else "warning",
        text = paste0(e$name, ": ", if (e$status == "error") e$error else paste(length(e$changes), "changes since the baseline"))
      ))
    }
  }
}
if (nrow(issues)) {
  simple_table(
    data.frame(
      `Package or service` = pkg_link(issues$package, ifelse(grepl("^api/", issues$github_url), issues$github_url, paste0("package/", issues$package, ".html"))),
      Problem = paste(ifelse(issues$level == "error", "<strong>Action needed:</strong>", ""), issues$text),
      check.names = FALSE
    )
  )
} else {
  cat("Nothing needs attention.")
}
```

## Unreleased changes

Packages with a newer version on GitHub than on CRAN.

```{r}
#| results: asis
if (nrow(unreleased)) {
  simple_table(
    data.frame(
      Package = pkg_link(unreleased$package, paste0("package/", unreleased$package, ".html")),
      CRAN = unreleased$cran_version,
      GitHub = unreleased$github_version,
      `Last commit` = format(unreleased$last_commit, "%d %b %Y"),
      check.names = FALSE
    )
  )
} else {
  cat("All CRAN packages are up to date with GitHub.")
}
```

## Open pull requests

```{r}
#| results: asis
if (nrow(with_prs)) {
  simple_table(
    data.frame(
      Package = pkg_link(with_prs$package, paste0("package/", with_prs$package, ".html")),
      `Pull requests` = pkg_link(with_prs$open_prs, paste0(with_prs$github_url, "/pulls")),
      check.names = FALSE
    )
  )
} else {
  cat("No open pull requests.")
}
```
